interpretation.range_support: 338 schedules (15.34%) contain at least one conservatively parsed multi-week range.
interpretation.high_coverage_subset: 980 schedules resolve at least 16 weeks without a date parser or language model.
interpretation.remaining_work: Missing cells include free text, date-only schedules, bare numbered tables, topicless headings, and weeks the teacher did not publish.
interpretation.ambiguity: The 1.85% ambiguous lookup cells include bilingual duplicate rows and genuinely overlapping same-width ranges; they must not be arbitrarily collapsed.

caveats: Counts measure extraction coverage, not semantic accuracy.
Only explicit Chinese or English week markers are parsed.
Date-only schedules, bare numbered tables, and free text require another stage.
The checked-in observed fixture covers 7 real range-heavy schedules, not a statistically sufficient production gold set.
